text: {"lessons":["A weak run is a prompt to review the portfolio and thesis, not to trade out of fear; make changes only when evidence or risk limits warrant them.","Adding to D and E without clear reasons and position limits increased exposure without a demonstrated edge; set a thesis, sizing rule, and exit conditions before buying.","My account has fallen from its early value despite several trades, so I should keep turnover low and judge decisions against a diversified market benchmark over the long run."]}
